node: Data-center thermal management: chillers, liquid cooling, controls, and service
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the AI data-center thermal-management node finds one high-attention reference anchor and three less-obvious US-listed suppliers with direct exposure to chillers, liquid-cooling systems, coolant distribution units, controls, or custom thermal-management equipment. The strongest underfollowed signal in this pass is Modine/Airedale, supported by disclosed AI/data-center cooling orders and a large long-term capacity agreement. AAON/BASX is a second direct candidate with disclosed liquid-cooling data-center orders. nVent is a component/platform candidate for CDUs, manifolds, racks, and power/cooling integration. Vertiv remains the reference leader for NVIDIA-aligned AI factory cooling architectures, but its market attention and market cap make it context rather than the primary alpha-hunt target.
